checkout.en: Check your belongings, close windows, turn off lights and return keys as agreed with your host.
checkout.sl: Preverite osebne stvari, zaprite okna, ugasnite luči in vrnite ključe po dogovoru z gostiteljem.

instructions.en: Open your reservation in the service you booked with and choose “Message the property” or reply to your host’s confirmation message. For an emergency, call 112.
instructions.sl: Odprite rezervacijo v storitvi, kjer ste rezervirali, in izberite sporočilo nastanitvi ali odgovorite na gostiteljevo potrditveno sporočilo. V nujnem primeru pokličite 112.

instructions.en: Check-in: {checkIn}. If you’re delayed, message your host.
Free private parking is listed. Ask your host for the approved parking space and arrival point before driving in.
instructions.sl: Na voljo je brezplačno zasebno parkirišče. Pred prihodom pri gostitelju preverite parkirno mesto in navodila za prihod.

instructions.en: Key collection and entry instructions are in your private reservation messages. Contact your host if you cannot find them. Access codes are never published in this guide.
instructions.sl: Navodila za prevzem ključev in vstop so v zasebnih sporočilih ob rezervaciji. Če jih ne najdete, pišite gostitelju. Kode za vstop niso nikoli objavljene v tem vodniku.

location.en: Ask your host where the controls are.

instructions.en: Heating instructions have not been supplied. Ask your host how to adjust the temperature; do not change boiler settings.
instructions.sl: Navodila za ogrevanje še niso na voljo. Za nastavitev temperature vprašajte gostitelja; ne spreminjajte nastavitev kotla.

location.en: Kitchen; exact appliance locations are not confirmed.
location.sl: Kuhinja; natančne lokacije naprav še niso potrjene.

instructions.en: Ask your host which kitchen equipment is available and how to use it. Hob, oven, coffee machine and dishwasher instructions have not been supplied.
instructions.sl: Pri gostitelju preverite, katera kuhinjska oprema je na voljo in kako jo uporabljati. Navodila za kuhalno ploščo, pečico, kavni aparat in pomivalni stroj še niso na voljo.

location.en: Availability and location are not confirmed.
location.sl: Razpoložljivost in lokacija še nista potrjeni.

instructions.en: Ask your host whether a washing machine is available and which programme and detergent to use.
instructions.sl: Pri gostitelju preverite, ali je pralni stroj na voljo ter kateri program in detergent uporabiti.

location.en: Availability and location are not confirmed.
location.sl: Razpoložljivost in lokacija še nista potrjeni.

instructions.en: Ask your host whether a TV is available and how to use the remote and select an input. Sign out of personal streaming accounts before leaving.
instructions.sl: Pri gostitelju preverite, ali je televizija na voljo ter kako uporabljati daljinec in izbrati vhod. Pred odhodom se odjavite iz osebnih pretočnih računov.

instructions.en: Quiet hours: {quietHours}. Be considerate of neighbours. Only registered guests may stay overnight.
instructions.sl: Nočni mir: {quietHours}. Bodite obzirni do sosedov. Prenočijo lahko le prijavljeni gostje.

instructions.en: The smoking policy has not been confirmed. Check your reservation or ask your host before smoking.
instructions.sl: Pravila glede kajenja še niso potrjena. Pred kajenjem preverite rezervacijo ali vprašajte gostitelja.

instructions.en: The pet policy has not been confirmed. Check with your host before bringing an animal.
instructions.sl: Pravila glede hišnih ljubljenčkov še niso potrjena. Pred prihodom z živaljo se posvetujte z gostiteljem.

instructions.en: Ask your host where the bins are and how to separate waste. Bin locations and collection instructions have not been supplied.
instructions.sl: Pri gostitelju preverite lokacijo zabojnikov in navodila za ločevanje odpadkov. Lokacije in navodila še niso na voljo.

instructions.en: Medical, fire & mountain rescue: 112. Police: 113. Address: {address}.
instructions.sl: Nujna medicinska pomoč, gasilci in gorski reševalci: 112. Policija: 113. Naslov: {address}.

location.en: Ask your host for the first-aid kit location.
location.sl: Za lokacijo kompleta prve pomoči vprašajte gostitelja.

instructions.en: The first-aid kit location has not been confirmed. In a medical emergency, call 112.
instructions.sl: Lokacija kompleta prve pomoči še ni potrjena. V nujnem zdravstvenem primeru pokličite 112.

location.en: Ask your host for safety equipment locations.
location.sl: Za lokacije varnostne opreme vprašajte gostitelja.

instructions.en: Fire extinguisher, fire blanket and alarm locations have not been confirmed. Ask your host where they are. If there is a fire, leave the building and call 112.
instructions.sl: Lokacije gasilnega aparata, požarne odeje in alarmov še niso potrjene. Zanje vprašajte gostitelja. Ob požaru zapustite stavbo in pokličite 112.
